summary: Iter-25 verified the new inline-child SRN/ERN model (children as sub-rows on parent items[]). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_inline_child_workflow.py covering TC1-TC12 (14 test methods). 10/14 PASS. CRITICAL FINDING: PUT and DELETE /api/short-received-notes/{srn_id}/children/{child_srn_no} (and ERN equivalents) ALL return 404 because child_srn_no contains '/' (e.g. 'SRN/26-27/001-A') — Starlette/uvicorn decodes %2F before path-routing, so the single-segment path param doesn't match. critical.issue: All four endpoints return 404 Not Found whenever the child id contains '/' (which it ALWAYS does — child ids look like 'SRN/26-27/001-A' or 'ERN/26-27/001-A'). Root cause: FastAPI route '/children/{child_srn_no}' uses default str converter that matches only ONE path segment, but Starlette/uvicorn decodes %2F to '/' BEFORE route matching, so the request path becomes /api/.../children/SRN/26-27/001-A (4 extra segments) — no route matches. Tested with both URL-encoded (quote(child_srn_no, safe='')) and raw forms — both 404. Backend log confirms decoded path 'PUT /api/extra-received-notes/31dff6fb.../children/ERN/26-27/006-A HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found'. Fix: change path param to `{child_srn_no:path}` (and `{child_ern_no:path}`) on lines 4293, 4372, 4694, 4757 of server.py — this enables matching paths that include '/'.

action_items: Change FastAPI route path params from '{child_srn_no}' / '{child_ern_no}' to '{child_srn_no:path}' / '{child_ern_no:path}' on PUT and DELETE child endpoints (server.py lines 4293, 4372, 4694, 4757). This is the only currently-broken contract; POST /children, GET, racking flow, status helpers, RN→FULLY_RACKED all work correctly.

Once route is fixed, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_iter25_inline_child_workflow.py — TC4/TC5/TC6/TC9 should pass with no test changes needed. The tests already URL-encode (urllib.parse.quote(child_id, safe='')).

The 4 failing tests (TC4 TestTC4EditChild, TC5 TestTC5EditDeleteBlockedByRkn, TC6 TestTC6DeleteChild, TC9 TestTC9ErnEditDeleteBlocked) all hit the SAME bug: 404 on PUT/DELETE because child id contains '/'. Backend route definitions need `:path` converter on the child_srn_no/child_ern_no path params. Once fixed, all 14 tests should pass without test code changes.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: FastAPI/Starlette path parameter '{child_srn_no}' uses the default str converter which matches a single URL path segment ([^/]+). Children IDs in this app are formatted as 'SRN/26-27/001-A' — they contain TWO forward slashes. Even when the client URL-encodes them as 'SRN%2F26-27%2F001-A', uvicorn/Starlette decodes the %2F BEFORE route matching (per WSGI/ASGI conventions), so the router sees '/api/short-received-notes/{srn_id}/children/SRN/26-27/001-A' and there is no matching route → 404. Reproduction: PUT to either encoded or raw URL — both return 404. Backend log confirms decoded path. MITIGATION: change path param converter to `:path` in server.py lines 4293, 4372, 4694, 4757 — `:path` permits embedded slashes by greedy-matching to the end of the URL. This is a one-character change per route (`{child_srn_no}` → `{child_srn_no:path}` and `{child_ern_no}` → `{child_ern_no:path}`) and requires no test changes.
